steps.sql: SELECT m.channel AS "渠道", ROUND(COALESCE(o.sales, 0) / NULLIF(m.spend, 0), 2) AS "ROI" FROM (SELECT channel, SUM(spend) AS spend FROM marketing_spend WHERE spend_date BETWEEN '2026-01-30' AND '2026-02-28' GROUP BY channel HAVING SUM(spend) > 0) AS m LEFT JOIN (SELECT channel, SUM(paid_amount) AS sales FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-30' AND '2026-02-28' GROUP BY channel) AS o ON m.channel = o.channel ORDER BY "ROI" DESC
